claim_scope: The in-plane hexagonal lattice parameter a of 2H-MoS2 as determined by Dickinson & Pauling (1923; COD 1010993): a = 3.15(2) Angstrom. ONE material property, scoped to the 2H polytype (bulk). Not a monolayer/few-layer or 3R value.

scientific_scope.conditions: ambient (temperature not separately recorded in the 1923 determination)
scientific_scope.form_scope_rule: This a is a 2H-bulk value; it must NOT be attached to monolayer/few-layer MoS2 or to the 3R polytype.

quantitative.numeric_convention: NUM-EN-DOT-DECIMAL: dot '.' is the decimal point; the value is a length in angstrom. The parenthetical '(2)' is the standard uncertainty in the last digit (0.02 A), stored separately, not part of the machine value.
